Application Data.NAME: Gourmet Catering Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Catering Co. specializes in providing high-quality catering services for corporate events, weddings, and private parties. Our operations include food preparation and presentation, menu planning, and on-site service. We focus on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients and maintain a strict adherence to health and safety regulations. However, our fleet of catering vehicles is equipped with basic fire extinguishers only and we do not have installed fire suppression systems. We do not operate as a bar or provide entertainment services at events. Our business model is designed to ensure customer satisfaction while prioritizing food safety and quality, but we acknowledge the need for enhanced fire safety measures in our operations.
